sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Nervous, uneasy, desire to recline, tired,
cannot settle down to any occupation. Periodic head-
aches, occipital pain, extending down to spine, worse
lying on back; sore pain in eyes.

sections.label: Back
sections.text:
Stiff, numb sensation, worse in neck. Spine
sore. Awakened in morning with burning soles. Spinal
pains, legs and arms heavy and weak, cannot lie on back.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Dull aching in ovaries, with sensation as
if menses appear. Hot flashes, followed by perspiration
on parts touching each other, when separated become
dry.
